FolderLink lets ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI apps read the project folders you choose, straight from your laptop. Read-only, logged, and revocable in one click.

## Install

macOS Apple silicon:

```bash
curl -L -o folderlink.tar.gz https://github.com/mmuizahmed/mcp-bridge/releases/latest/download/folderlink_darwin_arm64.tar.gz
tar -xzf folderlink.tar.gz
```

macOS Intel:

```bash
curl -L -o folderlink.tar.gz https://github.com/mmuizahmed/mcp-bridge/releases/latest/download/folderlink_darwin_amd64.tar.gz
tar -xzf folderlink.tar.gz
```

Linux x86_64:

```bash
curl -L -o folderlink.tar.gz https://github.com/mmuizahmed/mcp-bridge/releases/latest/download/folderlink_linux_x86_64.tar.gz
tar -xzf folderlink.tar.gz
```

Linux arm64:

```bash
curl -L -o folderlink.tar.gz https://github.com/mmuizahmed/mcp-bridge/releases/latest/download/folderlink_linux_arm64.tar.gz
tar -xzf folderlink.tar.gz
```

Windows: download `folderlink_windows_amd64.zip` AND `folderlink-bg_windows_amd64.zip`, and unzip both into the same folder. The bg zip holds `folderlink-bg.exe`, the no-console build that runs in the background with the tray icon.

Then:

```bash
folderlink allow ~/projects/my-app --label my-app
folderlink install
```

Run `folderlink install` — not `folderlink` on its own. Running `folderlink` directly opens a terminal window, and the connection dies when you close it. `folderlink install` copies the app to a stable folder (so it keeps working if you move or delete the download), registers it to start at login, and starts it right away — no terminal window. A FolderLink icon appears in the system tray (Windows): click it for the connection status, the dashboard, restart, or quit. If something looks wrong, run `folderlink doctor`.

Pair the laptop at https://folderlink.muiz.pk/pair and add the connector at https://folderlink.muiz.pk/mcp.

## In this release

- Four new read-only bridge tools: `search_files` (grep across approved folders, with line numbers), `read_media` (images), `file_info` (size, modified time, git-ignored flag), and `list_folders`.
- Presence: the dashboard now distinguishes paired from actually online, and the offline error shows when the device was last seen.
- Activity history: every tool call is logged to D1 (which app, which folder, whether it worked), kept for 30 days. File contents are never stored.
- Background service: `folderlink install` / `uninstall`, plus a no-console Windows build (`folderlink-bg.exe`).

## Known limits

- File writes and command execution are not in this release — they need the approval UI first.
- The hosted service needs the Deploy workflow run after this release (D1 migration 0006 + worker deploy).
- Some MCP clients can still be blocked by Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode on `/mcp` until the WAF fix is applied (turn Bot Fight Mode off, add a skip rule for `/mcp`).
- Release archives are not signed. Signing stays off until `COSIGN_YES` is set.
